name: In-situ formation of solid D2 pellets at ~7 K in a cryogen-free pulse-tube cryostat for two-stage light-gas-gun launching at 2-4 km/s (ENEA-ORNL IPI)
plain_name: Freeze deuterium fuel into ice bullets near 7 K and fire them at kilometres per second
description: High-speed pellet fuelling R&D for DEMO on the ENEA-ORNL four-barrel Ignitor Pellet Injector: D2 ice frozen in situ under constant gas pressure, cooled to ~7 K and held stable before two-stage gun launch; with a PT810 the freezing zone only reached ~10 K and pellets broke above 2 km/s, a PT415 (1.5 W at 4.2 K) lowered it to ~7.5 K.
keywords: Freeze deuterium fuel into ice bullets near 7 K and fire them at kilometres per second

sources.citation: Frattolillo et al., Core fueling of DEMO by direct line injection of high-speed pellets from the HFS, EUROfusion preprint WPTFV-CPR(17) 17238

reported_equipment: Ignitor Pellet Injector (IPI), ENEA-ORNL four-barrel pipe-gun injector

requirements.rationale: Pellet ice must be lowered to ~7 K and kept stable.
Upgraded cooler (1.5 W at 4.2 K) chosen to improve ice quality.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
